issues.anchor: If the ascendant were not afflicted, or the Lord thereof out of his essentiall Dignities
issues.observation: Only the first predicate prints not; adverse dignities/aspects then appear in an OR sequence whose stated conclusion is no sickness. The following paragraph supplies multiple favourable or un-afflicted alternatives.
retained_readings: Literal local negation: not-afflicted ascendant OR lord out of dignity OR evil-aspect conditions.
Elliptical distributed negation: not afflicted, and the intended negatives extend over the adverse lord predicates.
issues.disposition: Do not silently insert not or publish a single executable polarity. Keep full chain and source-linked ambiguity.
issues.blocking_scope: Exact executable Boolean interpretation of A008; source inventory can proceed.

issues.observation: Diurnal adverse predicates mix conjunction, comma, semicolon, and explicit or; nocturnal extension adds only consideratis considerandis.
retained_readings: Qualitative cluster of adverse conditions.
A family of alternative testimonies with diurnal/under-earth context.
issues.disposition: Preserve every item and the qualified transfer; do not assert a complete conjunction or individually sufficient alternatives, and do not fabricate a nocturnal inversion.
issues.blocking_scope: Exact executable combination rule and nocturnal adaptation.

issues.anchor: Although formerly I have briefly given directions herein
issues.observation: The governing heading is DARIOT Abridged; explicit marginal names alternate on printed259-260. The quality/nature subsection follows Lilly's first-person voice but provides no new marginal author name for its planetary clauses.
retained_readings: Lilly's continuing exposition under the prior explicit Lilly attribution.
Mixed or abridged Dariot material edited by Lilly.
issues.disposition: Attribution ambiguous for planetary rules, with evidence recorded; do not pretend an independently inspected original Dariot edition.
issues.blocking_scope: Exact sentence-level original-authorship claim, not the faithfully anchored source meaning.

issues.anchor: if Saturne be mixed in the Judgement
issues.observation: The semicolon follows some mixture of Melancholly; the gloss ends or Mars in any of his dignities. Saturn is the most natural antecedent of his, but the possessive is not expanded.
retained_readings: Melancholy mixture depends on Saturn involvement, including Mars in Saturn's dignities.
A strictly local transcription retains his without resolving the antecedent.
issues.disposition: Attach the if to melancholy and keep the dignity referent explicitly unresolved rather than writing Mars's own dignities as certain.

issues.disposition: Preserve placement and alternatives; do not omit either capable or youth/distemper.
